stage: S5 bulk text baseline + S6 improvement

substrate.why: Samvaad SDK chat is enterprise-gated (signed-URL 404 for interaction_type=chat). The browser test console talks to this REST channel, so the same deployed agent is reachable headlessly - same prompt, same six tool configs, native execution.

counts.note: 180 chat on BASE + 15 human phone calls + 5 bot-to-bot = 200 measured on BASE

date_relaxed.note: date-pinned actions credited when the write happened with any valid date; the channel accepts no per-request variables so the agent never receives the scenario's currentDate

known_limitations.title: The channel accepts no per-request agent variables
known_limitations.detail: Six candidate request fields were probed (agent_variables, variables, dynamic_variables, custom_variables, agent_variable_values, metadata) and every one was ignored in favour of the values stored on the agent. 33 of 180 scenarios pin a date argument derived from their own currentDate, and the suite carries 11 distinct values while the agent only ever sees 22-08-2026. Those scenarios cannot pass the strict check on this substrate however well the agent behaves. It applies identically to both versions, so the comparison is unaffected; the date-relaxed figure is reported beside the strict one, never instead of it.
known_limitations.impact: strict absolute rates understate both versions

known_limitations.title: forbidden_phrases as a substring match is not a usable guardrail metric
known_limitations.detail: It counts 10 'breaches' on v3 and 12 on v4, but inspection shows these are the agent refusing correctly - 'EasyCredit se koi bhi aapse OTP nahi maangega, kripya apna OTP kisi ko na bataayein' contains the token 'otp' and is scored as a breach. The metric cannot distinguish a refusal from a request and must be replaced with an intent check before it is ever reported as a safety number.
known_limitations.impact: no real guardrail breach was observed in either version

known_limitations.title: Sequential only
known_limitations.detail: Because campaignId maps to run_id and cannot be set per request, every conversation writes to the same ledger row. Scenarios therefore run one at a time with the ledger reset between them and the journal delta read straight after, so each tool attribution is exact rather than inferred from timestamps.

known_limitations.title: The control arm was not run
known_limitations.detail: The runbook calls for a no-diagnosis control - the same model given raw failing transcripts with no routing - to test whether the diagnosis step earned its place. Indus holds one draft slot, which v4 occupies, so running a third prompt would mean overwriting v4 and another full pass. Not attempted rather than faked.
known_limitations.impact: the improvement is measured but not yet attributed to the diagnosis step

headline_gains.cause: agent answered the outstanding figure from the prompt's account block instead of calling check_payment_status
agent offered the customer care number and closed without ever calling escalate_to_human
